subject: City Property Inventory and Maintenance Costs
overview: The committee met to discuss a resolution requesting a comprehensive inventory and maintenance cost assessment of all city-owned and managed properties.

items.title: Paper 24-034: Facilities Report Request
items.summary: The committee kept the resolution in committee after discussing the request for a city property inventory and maintenance cost assessment with the Facilities Manager, who agreed to provide an initial property spreadsheet and a cost estimate for an external consulting assessment.
